dataset.name: Norwegian road tolls (bompenger, AutoPASS toll stations)
dataset.method: Veglova § 27 and the toll projects' Storting decisions; prices per passage for large vehicles (takstgruppe 2, over 3,500 kg) as registered for each AutoPASS toll station in NVDB, Statens vegvesen's national road database (object type 45 Bomstasjon), with the charged direction and the hour rule (timesregel: after a paid passage the project's other stations are free for the time given). Rush-hour prices are higher at some stations: the off-peak price is used. Tolls carry no VAT.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

network.description: 424 AutoPASS toll stations, each charged when the route passes it in a charged direction.
